scope: Targeted coverage supplement to registry.json; not an exhaustive global inventory.

registryMethod.deduplication: NCT ID; all IDs already in registry.json excluded from registry-extra.json.
registryMethod.schema: Same as registry.json: asOf, searches, studies. Study fields are mapped without interpretation from ClinicalTrials.gov API v2.
registryMethod.searchCounts: searches.count is the raw API response count before relevance filtering and deduplication. All searches completed with nextPage=false.
registryMethod.dates: Study updated means registry lastUpdatePostDateStruct.date, not the date of a clinical event or efficacy cutoff. Enrollment is a registry planning/actual enrollment field, never an efficacy-evaluable denominator.
registryMethod.statusRule: Preserve registry status; display later corporate program decisions separately. A registry phase label PHASE2/PHASE3 does not prove the Phase 3 portion started.

programs.boundary: core: individualized neoantigen mRNA cancer vaccine
programs.setting: Resected pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma; randomized adjuvant vaccine + atezolizumab + mFOLFIRINOX versus mFOLFIRINOX.
programs.delivery: Intravenous RNA-lipoplex; distinguish from intramuscular LNP products.
programs.statusNote: API: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, updated 2026-09-09; Phase 2; estimated enrollment 260, not an efficacy analysis population.

programs.boundary: core: shared tumor-associated antigen mRNA vaccine; historical program
programs.payload: Six NSCLC-associated antigens: MUC1, survivin, NY-ESO-1, 5T4, MAGE-C2, MAGE-C1.
programs.delivery: RNActive platform; intradermal administration. NCT03164772 includes PharmaJet Tropis device. Do not normalize as LNP.
programs.statusNote: NCT03164772 COMPLETED; NCT01915524 TERMINATED for slow recruitment in stratum 3. Trial completion does not establish a currently active commercial development program.

programs.boundary: adjacent: ex vivo CAR-T plus an RNA vaccine that amplifies CAR-T; not in vivo CAR generation and not vaccine monotherapy
programs.delivery: CLDN6 CAR-T intravenous infusion; CLDN6-encoding RNA-LPX intravenous injections.
programs.statusNote: API ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING (2026-06-18). BioNTech Q3 2026 states enrollment complete, CARVac treatment/follow-up ongoing and no further clinical development currently planned. Both facts must remain visible.

programs.boundary: core RNA-containing heterologous regimen: personalized neoantigen adenoviral prime plus saRNA boost; separate from conventional mRNA-only vaccines
programs.delivery: GRT-C901: replication-defective chimpanzee adenovirus 68; GRT-R902: self-amplifying RNA encapsulated in LNP. Intramuscular prime/boost; not two names for the same product.
programs.statusNote: API: NCT05141721 ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, last updated 2025-05-16; NCT03639714 COMPLETED; NCT05456165 WITHDRAWN, actual enrollment 0, due to reprioritization. Gritstone entered Chapter 11 in 2024 and a court sale was approved; no unverified inference that every trial is terminated or that the successor is currently conducting development.
programs.phaseCaution: NCT05141721 records PHASE2 and PHASE3 and estimated enrollment 700. This planned registration description is not evidence that Phase 3 began or 700 participants were treated.

programs.boundary: core: whole-tumor RNA approach; not selected-mutation neoantigen mRNA vaccine
programs.payload: Autologous total tumor mRNA plus pp65 full-length LAMP mRNA.
programs.delivery: DOTAP liposomes; intravenous RNA-loaded lipid particles. Adult newly diagnosed GBM and pediatric high-grade glioma strata must be kept distinct.
programs.statusNote: API RECRUITING, updated 2026-10-30; Phase 1; estimated enrollment 28. Primary purpose includes manufacturing feasibility, safety and MTD, not a confirmed survival benefit.

programs.boundary: core: shared ovarian tumor-associated antigen mRNA vaccine; historical terminated study
programs.delivery: Three ovarian-cancer TAA RNA-LPX products; intravenous administration with neoadjuvant/adjuvant chemotherapy.
programs.statusNote: API TERMINATED for failure to reach the target evaluable population despite extended recruitment; actual enrollment 8. BioNTech 2023 20-F says 10 recruited, 8 dosed, follow-up completed June 2023 and no follow-up studies planned. Keep recruited/dosed/registry-enrolled counts separate.

programs.boundary: core: shared mutant-KRAS neoantigen mRNA vaccine; do not merge its two distinct protocols
programs.delivery: Intramuscular mRNA vaccination. Lipid formulation details not inferred from platform branding.
programs.statusNote: API: both RECRUITING. NCT06577532 EARLY_PHASE1 (56 estimated, toripalimab); NCT07455617 PHASE1 (101 estimated, sintilimab). Sponsor's 2025 dual IND announcement is authorization to test, not marketing approval or clinical efficacy.

programs.boundary: core: shared/multi-antigen mRNA vaccine; separate from personalized ZY008
programs.delivery: LNP using proprietary cationic lipid YK-009; intramuscular injection per registry.
programs.statusNote: API RECRUITING, updated 2026-10-13; Phase 1; 76 estimated. HLA-A*11:01 plus target-antigen selection restricts eligibility; not an unrestricted pan-cancer vaccine. Primary endpoints are DLT/TEAE/SAE.

programs.boundary: adjacent clinical indication: HPV16-positive cervical HSIL (precancer); HPV-associated solid-tumor development remains exploratory in cited announcement
programs.delivery: mRNA encoding HPV16 E6/E7; proprietary LNP per 2024 company disclosure.
programs.statusNote: Exact-name ClinicalTrials.gov API search returned 0, not proof of no trials. Luye 2026-08-20 announced a Chinese Phase 2 HSIL study would start; do not convert 'would start' into recruiting or completed Phase 2. Company reports Phase 1 HPV clearance near 90%, but supplies no public denominator/CI in that announcement; do not chart as confirmed tumor response or compare with ORR.

programs.boundary: core: personalized mRNA vaccine in advanced solid tumors; separately registered outside ClinicalTrials.gov
programs.statusNote: ChiCTR original-page search index identifies a prospective registration dated 2026-01-26 and single-arm design. Direct fetch returned HTTP 405. No NCT ID, sponsor, delivery formulation, recruiting status, enrollment or results are invented.

exclusions.reason: API returned CD19 CARvac T cells in B-cell malignancies. This is not BioNTech BNT211/CLDN6 RNA CARVac; no demonstrated administered mRNA vaccine in retrieved record. Excluded instead of matching on CARvac spelling alone.

exclusions.trigger: GRANITE OR GRT-C901 OR GRT-R902 exploratory search
exclusions.reason: Broad GRANITE search also finds non-oncology devices, observational studies, GI drugs and screening-only protocols. Final saved searches use exact GRT identifiers; only interventional RNA-containing cancer-vaccine trials retained.

remainingGaps: ClinicalTrials.gov exact LY01620 search found no records; China CDE/ChiCTR protocol identifiers, complete Phase 1 denominators and Phase 2 recruitment need direct verification.
ZY008 ChiCTR direct page blocked with HTTP 405; current status, sponsor, route, enrollment and results remain unverified.
Post-sale ownership and operational continuity of individual GRANITE trials are not established by the cited bankruptcy and sale documents.
This supplement does not establish a complete ex vivo DC-mRNA, circRNA or in vivo CAR inventory; no absence claim is made.
No newly extracted efficacy or safety estimates are imputed from registry enrollment, trial design, IND clearance or corporate program status.
